reviewer.notes: Fresh-context independent review on Windows/NTFS (CPython 3.14.6). Falsification attempted with discriminating pairs where lower() and casefold() disagree: 'STRASSE.md' vs 'Straße.md' (control: lower gives 'strasse.md' vs 'straße.md', i.e. lower MISSES) -- implementation find_casefold_collisions returned collision_group_count=1, key='strasse.md', paths=['STRASSE.md','Straße.md'], keys of both inputs = 'strasse.md'; 'file-σ.md' vs 'file-ς.md' (sigma vs final sigma; lower MISSES) -- group_count=1, key='file-σ.md'. NFC applied: NFD 'Café.md' vs NFC 'café.md' -- keys both 'café.md', group formed over NFC-normalised exacts; 'ẛ.md' vs 'ẛ.md' -- keys both 'ṡ.md' (NFC composed U+017F+U+0307 to U+1E9B before casefold; a no-NFC key would yield 'ṡ.md' and differ). NFC-before-casefold ORDER anchored in code at tools/plugin/casefold_paths.py:88-95 (nfc_path() then .casefold()); on this build full folding commutes with composition (verified premise), so no behavioral order claim is made -- the counter-example hunt is in command-center/p2-wave/reviews/IMP-0022/casefold-nfc-discrimination.raw.txt (24/24 checks PASS). Negative controls: exact-duplicate dedupe (README.md x2 => group of exactly 2), clean set 0 groups. Packer pre-emit refusal re-proven on NTFS via an index-built colliding git tree (tools/plugin/pack.py:271-275): PackError named both paths, no zip emitted. Unit probes rerun green here, including catalog signal (2) on a real case-insensitive filesystem: NTFS extraction of the planted zip gave archive_entry_count=2, extracted_file_count=1, shortfall=1 (settles the Linux worker's missing-CI-FS-substrate block; reviews/IMP-0022/probe2-ci-fs-extract.raw.txt). pytest 4/5 on NTFS: test_packer_refuses_planted_case_collision is substrate-blocked (its own comment assumes Linux coexistence; on NTFS the second write overwrites -- corroborated: case-variant double-write leaves 1 name), intent independently confirmed by the index-tree check. Residual (LOW, APFS-only): NFC-composition variants dedupe as exact duplicates rather than being flagged. Receipt artifact hashes (2026-09-08 Linux pack) drift from the live worktree (edits by other lanes); this PASS certifies the live worktree bytes actually executed.
reviewer.prior_implementer_notes: Implementer emit only. Signal (1) CONFIRMED on this Linux worker (planted README.md/readme.md collision_group_count=1; NFC pair collapses; clean set silent). Signal (2) NOT CONFIRMED: host filesystem is case-sensitive ext4; no IMP0022_CI_FS_ROOT case-insensitive mount provided; diagnostic extract of planted zip lands both members (shortfall=0) — inventing a CI-FS shortfall is forbidden. Catalog reviewer_requirement also unmet: independent reviewer must confirm normalisation is casefold (not lower()) with NFC applied first. SUCCESS:IMP-0022 not invented; independent-review.json not invented.
